scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-builder/contracts && npm run build -w @agent-builder/generator-cli && npm run build -w @agent-builder/backend && npm run build -w @agent-builder/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @agent-builder/backend" "npm run dev -w @agent-builder/frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:backend && npm run test:cli && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:prepare: npm run build -w @agent-builder/contracts && npm run build -w @agent-builder/generator-cli
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:prepare && npm run test:backend -- --coverage && npm run test:frontend -- --coverage
